correctness.rationale: The pair-star gives eight edges and is directly 3-union-free. For the upper bound and equality classification, vertex symmetry fixes the first triple and reduces the second triple to the three possible intersection-size orbits. I independently implemented the hereditary union-collision search using a different candidate ordering from the packaged verifier. All three 9-edge searches were empty, with independent node counts 21112, 115449 and 110676; all three 8-edge non-pair-star searches were also empty, with counts 27951, 148500 and 138479. Because every rejected extension already creates equal unions among subfamilies of size at most three and that collision persists under further extensions, the DFS is exhaustive rather than a timeout or partial enumeration. This independently reproduces \(U_3(10,3)=8\) and uniqueness of the pair-star up to relabeling.
